title: SEC1: bt5.4 node_id derives from signing key in reader, not from file
description: bt5.4 (transit/main.rs) uses a file-persisted random node_id stable across key rotations. But crates/reader/src/store/server_stores.rs still derives node_id from the signing key via hlc_node_id() (SHA-256 of public key, first 8 bytes). If the reader crate's signing key is rotated (or an ephemeral key is used), the HLC node_id silently changes. The two binaries (transit and reader) have inconsistent node_id stability semantics, which will be confusing when the reader's POST path participates in a shared group log. The comment in server_stores.rs says 'Stable across restarts (as long as the key is the same)' — correct, but key rotation breaks it. Mitigation: reader should also use a file-persisted node_id or the config-pinned hex approach, consistent with transit.
